b1-26-01.title: Communicative Challenge: My Plans for Next Year
b1-26-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You work in an office in Budapest. Meg, a student, asks what you plan to do next year.
b1-26-01.prompt: Tell Meg what you will do next year and what you want to devote yourself to.
cues: Say what you will look for next year
Say what you want to devote yourself to
b1-26-01.target: El año que viene buscaré un trabajo nuevo. Quiero dedicarme a la investigación.
b1-26-01.english: Next year I will look for a new job. I want to work in research.
b1-26-01.canDo: I can discuss career plans and intentions.

b1-26-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is Success?
b1-26-02.scenario: You are Meg. You are a student in Budapest. Carlos asks what success means to you.
b1-26-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what is more important to you, success or money.
b1-26-02.target: Para mí, el éxito es más importante que el dinero.
b1-26-02.english: For me, success is more important than money.
b1-26-02.canDo: I can evaluate and compare different ideas of success.

b1-26-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Matters Most
b1-26-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg, a student in Budapest, works a lot and has no free time. You tell her what you think is important.
b1-26-03.prompt: Tell Meg what is important and what is better for her.
cues: Say what is important for everyone
Say what is better for her
b1-26-03.target: Es importante que tengamos tiempo para nosotros. Es mejor que busques un equilibrio.
b1-26-03.english: It is important that we have time for ourselves. It is better for you to look for a balance.
b1-26-03.canDo: I can express priorities and opinions about work and life.

b1-26-04.title: Communicative Challenge: If I Had More Time
b1-26-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you would do if you had more free time.
b1-26-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what you would do if you had more time.
b1-26-04.target: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría más.
b1-26-04.english: If I had more time, I would travel more.
b1-26-04.canDo: I can discuss hypothetical choices about work and time.

b1-26-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Marianela and Pablo
b1-26-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read a retelling of «Marianela», a novel by Benito Pérez Galdós, for a class in Budapest. Carlos asks what happens.
b1-26-05.prompt: Tell Carlos who Pablo is and what the doctor says.
b1-26-05.target: Pablo es un joven ciego. El doctor lo opera y Pablo puede ver, pero Nela, que lo quería, muere de tristeza.
b1-26-05.english: Pablo is a young blind man. The doctor operates on him and Pablo can see, but Nela, who loved him, dies of grief.
b1-26-05.canDo: I can build a sustained argument about work and success.

b1-26-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Balanced Life
b1-26-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You work in an office in Budapest. Meg asks you what your priority is and what you would change.
b1-26-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg your priority and what you would do with more time.
cues: Say what you would do with more time
b1-26-consolidation.target: Para mí, el equilibrio es una prioridad porque necesito tiempo para otras cosas. Si tuviera más tiempo, trabajaría menos.
b1-26-consolidation.english: For me, balance is a priority because I need time for other things. If I had more time, I would work less.
b1-26-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for work and ambition.
